description: This study abroad course introduces students to the life and thought of Niccolo Machiavelli as a
window into Renaissance Italy, Ancient Rome, and Modern Europe. Students not only trace
Machiavelli's career and aspirations through the streets of Florence and Rome, they also explore
the way in which his political and literary works continue to shape the way in which Ancient Rome
is presented to tourists and national identity is promoted by politicians. Offered alternate years
fullname: Machiavelli's Shadow: Politics and Power in Italy (study abroad)
